# bits

> Bit twiddling: ~x, compound assignment for <<, >>, &, | and ^, and bit functions.

[source](../../registry/bits.pkg) · truck

```
use std
use bits

let flags = 0
flags |= 1 << 3
flags ^= 1
flags &= ~1
print bit_get(flags, 3)       // true
print bit_count(255)          // 8
print bit_str(flags, 8)       // 00001000
```

| package | gives |
|---|---|
| `bits/bnot` | `~x`: every bit flipped |
| `bits/shl_assign`, `bits/shr_assign` | `x <<= n`, `x >>= n` |
| `bits/band_assign`, `bits/bor_assign`, `bits/bxor_assign` | `x &= y`, `x \|= y`, `x ^= y` |
| `bits/ops` | `bit_count`, `bit_lz`, `bit_tz`, `bit_rotl`, `bit_get`, `bit_set`, `bit_field`, `bit_ushr` (logical shift), `bit_str` and more |

The assignments and `~` expand into `std` operators, so they work with
every backend. Pair with `stdx` for `+=` and friends.

## Packages

| package | summary |
|---|---|
| [bits/bnot](bits/bnot.md) | Bitwise not: ~x flips every bit of an int. |
| [bits/shl_assign](bits/shl_assign.md) | Shift-left assignment: x <<= y, short for x = x << y. |
| [bits/shr_assign](bits/shr_assign.md) | Shift-right assignment: x >>= y, short for x = x >> y. |
| [bits/band_assign](bits/band_assign.md) | Bitwise-and assignment: x &= y, short for x = x & y. |
| [bits/bor_assign](bits/bor_assign.md) | Bitwise-or assignment: x \|= y, short for x = x \| y. |
| [bits/bxor_assign](bits/bxor_assign.md) | Bitwise-xor assignment: x ^= y, short for x = x ^ y. |
| [bits/ops](bits/ops.md) | Bit operations on ints: counting, rotating, single bits, fields, logical shifts and binary text. |
